item.title: French sailor goes running, reveals flagship’s location via fitness app
item.description: The French aircraft carrier the Charles de Gaulle is on its way to the Middle East. One sailor’s run pinpointed its position.

item.title: Army receives a new Black Hawk helicopter, pilot optional
item.description: The new H-60Mx now goes to testing as the Army works to expand its autonomous and remote-controlled arsenal.

item.title: National Guard mobilized for search and rescue operations amid Hawaii floods
item.description: Troops have helped rescue more than 200 people as large parts of Oahu remain drenched from flash floods in recent days.

item.title: Senator references Iwo Jima while pushing for US to take Kharg Island
item.description: Sen. Lindsey Graham recently referenced the bloody World War II battle while arguing for U.S. troops to seize the island from Iran.

item.title: Navy destroyer with grizzly bear battle flag pays tribute to heroic Marine
item.description: The ship’s namesake, retired Marine Col. Harvey C. Barnum Jr, was awarded the Medal of Honor for his heroism in Vietnam

item.title: Air Force reactivates Reaper drone squadron at Nevada base
item.description: The Air Force reactivated the 42nd Attack Squadron at Creech Air Force Base, Nevada, to fly overseas missions with the MQ-9 Reaper drone.

item.title: USS Gerald R. Ford’s ‘record-breaking’ deployment could last 11 months, top admiral says
item.description: The USS Gerald R. Ford has taken part in operations in the Caribbean and Middle East since getting underway last June.

item.title: Apache crews who buzzed Kid Rock’s home won’t be punished, Hegseth says
item.description: The singer posted a video on social media that appeared to show two of the Army helicopters buzzing his home outside Nashville, Tennessee.

item.title: Troops in Qatar, UAE, 8 other regions now get combat pay for Epic Fury
item.description: The Pentagon has authorized troops in parts of the Middle East to receive special types of combat pay depending on where they are.

item.title: Here's what Marine Expeditionary Units are designed to do
item.description: The units are embarked on ships and include air and ground combat elements along with logistics and command structures.

item.title: Infantry, artillery, other combat arms troops had highest suicide risk in 2024
item.description: A new Pentagon report found that troops in combat arms fields like infantry and artillery had higher suicide risks in 2024.

item.title: Army 'pauses' plan to close more than 20 base museums
item.description: The Army has 45 facilities in its museum network, and planned to close about half. Now congress is weighing in.

item.title: 82nd Airborne Division cancels All American Week amid Iran war deployments
item.description: An event honoring service members and veteran paratroopers at Fort Bragg, North Carolina, has been cancelled amid “competing requirements.”

item.title: How does the Iran war end?
item.description: No one in the U.S. government seems to be able to say what it will take to achieve the Trump administration’s stated objectives in Iran.

item.title: Hegseth asks top Army officer to step down
item.description: The Army’s chief of staff is the latest senior military leader to be ousted during Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s tenure.
